BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a balanced state budget; adding a new section tochapter 43.88 RCW; and providing for submission of this act to a voteof the people.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.88 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) For the 2014 fiscal year or any subsequent fiscal year, thelegislature may not present to the governor for consideration, nor maythe governor sign into law, an appropriations bill that wouldappropriate from the general fund for that fiscal year a total amountthat, when combined with all appropriations from the general fund forthat fiscal year made as of the date of the appropriation bill'spassage and the amount of any general fund moneys to be transferred tothe budget stabilization account, exceeds the prior fund balance andany general fund revenues for that fiscal year as estimated by theeconomic and revenue forecast council or successor entity as of thedate of the budget bill's passage. (2) For the 2014 fiscal year or any subsequent fiscal year, thelegislature may not present to the governor for consideration, nor may p. 1 SB 6596the governor sign into law, an appropriations bill that would requirefor any of the subsequent five fiscal years general fund appropriationsnecessary to maintain estimated program and service levels funded inthat appropriations bill, of a total amount that, when combined withall projected appropriations from the general fund for that fiscal yearand the amount of any general fund moneys projected to be transferredto the budget stabilization account, exceeds prior fund balances andgeneral fund revenues for that fiscal year as estimated by the economicand revenue forecast council or successor entity as of the date of thebudget bill's passage.

The secretary of state shall submit this actto the people for their adoption and ratification, or rejection, at thenext general election to be held in this state, in accordance withArticle II, section 1 of the state Constitution and the laws adopted tofacilitate its operation.
